claim.statement: Current Lovable documentation says the main agent can start temporary read-only subagents for research, code exploration and review, can run several independent subagents in parallel, and receives their findings before deciding what to do next; subagents cannot change the project and Lovable decides when to use them.

source.title: Subagents
source.locator: Introduction, How subagents work and FAQ — Can multiple subagents run at once?

limitations: The publisher claim supports conditional parallel read-only investigation, not parallel project-writing agents or a fixed number of concurrent subagents.
unknowns: Whether subagents ran, their count, task briefings, model routes, tool calls, findings and timing are unknown.

relationships.note: Temporary read-only subagents may investigate in parallel, while the main Build-mode prompt queue processes one task at a time; subagents cannot apply project changes.
